images.title: Sums of neighbour evens
images.purpose: Show that adding neighbouring even numbers gives 6, 10, 14, 18, up by 4 each time.
images.composition: Row of 5 circles in the middle, 4 arcs above joining neighbours, sums row below.
images.exact_structure: One row of 5 equal circles, evenly spaced, holding 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, all teal #0072B2 outline with white fill. Four grey #6B7280 arcs above, each joining two neighbouring circles. Under the row, four amber #E69F00 sum numbers 6, 10, 14, 18 each centred under its pair. One caption at the bottom. Exactly 5 circles and 4 arcs.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
arcs joining circles that are not neighbours
images.takeaway: Neighbouring evens add to numbers that go up by 4.
images.description: Five circles holding 2 to 10 with four arcs over neighbouring pairs and sums 6, 10, 14, 18 below.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at an arc and say the sum of the two numbers it joins.

image_decisions.why: Arcs over neighbours make the pairing and the step of 4 easy to see.
